574-1445-2267-4871.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
574-1445-2267-4871.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
574-1445-2267-4871.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

739-4691-4971.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
739-4691-4971.description:
Activate Gideon of the Trials by putting zero loyalty counters on him, creating his emblem.
Draw a card.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Vilis triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 3 until your library is empty, preventing a game loss with Gideon of the Trials.

1290-7848.notablePrerequisites:
Three or more quest counters on Bloodchief Ascension.
You have a way to make an opponent lose life.
1290-7848.description:
Cause one or more opponents to lose life.
The Master of Lake-town triggers once for each life loss event, causing that player to mill cards equal to the amount of life lost.
Bloodchief Ascension triggers once for each card milled, causing that player to lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life for each trigger.
Repeat from step 2.

671-1594-4399-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Helm of Awakening.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Daxos trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Daxos trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
671-1594-4399-4518.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

647-1409-3099-6723.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

4091-4360-7791.description:
Activate Greenweaver Druid by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Greenweaver Druid.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Greenweaver Druid.
Repeat.

1619-4605-5542-6143-6797.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5542-6143-6797.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Feywild Caretaker from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Feywild Caretaker enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Feywild Caretaker.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Feywild Caretaker that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Feywild Caretaker token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Feywild Caretaker token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Feywild Caretaker that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Feywild Caretaker trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5542-6143-6797.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

3099-3129-4762-7704.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Doc Samson and Primal Vigor.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

539-2244-4803-5434.notablePrerequisites: You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {W}.
539-2244-4803-5434.description:
Activate a permanent by tapping it, adding at least {W}.
Activate Nimbleclaw Adept by tapping it, untapping Ruin Ghost and the permanent.
Activate Ruin Ghost by paying {W} and tapping it, blinking Nimbleclaw Adept.
Repeat.

6602-6798--5.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Tromell
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat

1170-7520.description:
Cast a copy of Craft With Pride by paying {R}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Goblin Glasswright, which enters prepared.
Resolve Craft With Pride, creating a Treasure token.
Activate that Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Oko, Lorwyn Liege // Oko, Shadowmoor Scion

1486-1753-2872-7176.description:
Activate Oko, Lorwyn Liege's first ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, causing Clever Conjurer to gain all creature types.
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, targeting Samut.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Clever Conjurer ability, untapping Samut.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Samut by paying {W} and tapping it, targeting Clever Conjurer.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Samut trigger, untapping Clever Conjurer.
Repeat from step 2.
1486-1753-2872-7176.notes: Once you have infinite Treasures, you may use them to activate Magda's ability.

539-5413-7034.description:
Cast Bumi by paying its mana cost
When Bumi enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing Bumi
When Bumi dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Bumi enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Trenching Steed ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1414-2292-2866-4986.description:
Cast Lotus Petal by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Lotus Petal from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

3257-3609-6099-6881.description:
Play Rakdos Carnarium. When it enters, it and Mossborn Hydra trigger.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Mossborn Hydra trigger, doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Moxite Refinery by paying {2}, tapping it and removing three +1/+1 counters from Mossborn Hydra, putting three charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
3257-3609-6099-6881.notes: You can remove as many +1/+1 counters from Mossborn Hydra to then place counters on Magistrate's Scepter. If you remove more than three, you may be able to forego steps 1-3 during some turns. You must ensure, however, that Mossborn Hydra will continue to have three or more +1/+1 counters on it afterwards.

1308-2653-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
1308-2653-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
1308-2653-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Nissa each trigger twice.
Resolve both Nissa triggers, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods tokens enters the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

1817-2921-5365.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Clue token.
1817-2921-5365.description:
Cast Lonis by paying {1}{G/U}{G/U}.
Holding priority, cast Double Major by paying {G}{U}, creating a nonlegendary copy of the Lonis spell.
Resolve both Lonis spells.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and the Lonis token's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the nontoken Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the token Lonis.
The token Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the token Lonis's trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on the nontoken Lonis.
The nontoken Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 4.
1817-2921-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

1247-5536-5711.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
Rex does not have summoning sickness.
Fanatic of Rhonas and Pili-Pala exiled with a brain counter on them.
1247-5536-5711.description:
Activate Rex using Fanatic of Rhonas's ability by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Rex using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

81-1323-4762.notablePrerequisites: Experiment Kraj does not have summoning sickness.
81-1323-4762.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj by tapping it, putting two +1/+1 counters onto Devoted Druid.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Devoted Druid's last ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on itself, untapping it.
Activate Experiment Kraj's own ability, putting two +1/+1 counters on itself.
Remove the -1/-1 counter and one of the +1/+1 counters from Experiment Kraj as a state-based action.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 any number of times, resulting in any number of +1/+1 counters on Experiment Kraj.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Devoted Druid's last ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on itself, untapping it.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, add {G}.
Repeat steps 6 and 7 any number of times.
You may also activate Experiment Kraj's own ability any number of times instead of step 7, putting any number of +1/+1 counters onto creatures.
Once there are infinite +1/+1 counters on your creatures, you may activate Experiment Kraj using Kami of Whispered Hope's ability any number of times, adding infinite mana of all colors.

1061-3395-4313.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U} each turn, plus an additional {3} or {U} available each turn
1061-3395-4313.notablePrerequisites: You have the city's blessing and/or control at least eight permanents.
1061-3395-4313.description:
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
If you don't have the city's blessing and control ten or more permanents, Timestream Navigator gives you the city's blessing.
When Timestream Navigator enters the battlefield, Flameshadow Conjuring triggers, causing you to pay {R} to create a token copy of Timestream Navigator with haste.
If you don't have the city's blessing, the Timestream Navigator token gives you the city's blessing.
Activate Crystal Shard by paying {3} or {U} and tapping it, returning the nontoken Timestream Navigator to your hand from the battlefield.
Activate the Timestream Navigator token by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it on the bottom of your library from the battlefield, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

4385-4434-4762-4875.notablePrerequisites:
Devoted Druid does not have a -1/-1 counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
"Treefolk" chosen with Conspiracy.
4385-4434-4762-4875.description:
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Sliver Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a 1/1 Sliver creature token.
When the Sliver enters the battlefield as a Treefolk due to Conspiracy, Quickbeam triggers, giving Devoted Druid and up to one other creature +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

1651-1737-4659-4715.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Prized Statue.
When the Prized Statue token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Prized Statue and Treasure, untapping Prototype Portal.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Prized Statue, adding {C}{C}.
Prized Statue triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.

57-1953-3057.notablePrerequisites:
Feldon does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
57-1953-3057.description:
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Bloodthirster with haste.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Brudiclad triggers, creating a 2/1 Phyrexian Myr artifact creature token, then causing each token you control to become a copy of the Bloodthirster token.
Deal combat damage with a Bloodthirster token.
The Bloodthirster token triggers, causing you to untap it and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.
